args.body: For SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT, reuse any completed verdict. description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback contains no newly interpreted requests, and five unclassified sources leave demand unknown. The latest SQLite package check ended at an unlabeled assertion, so it established neither package integrity nor a defect in the package. Queue a file-by-file readback that gives the checkout owner exact evidence for the redistribution decision.
